tasks.label: Build and Install qameleon
tasks.command: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build install && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=../install && make -j$(nproc) && make install
tasks.detail: Builds and installs the qameleon dependency

tasks.label: Build QameleonGui with pre-installed lib
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install -Dqameleon_DIR=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install/lib/cmake/qameleon && make -j$(nproc)
tasks.detail: Builds the QameleonGui project using the pre-installed qameleon library

tasks.label: Build all
tasks.command: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build install && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=../install && make -j$(nproc) && make install && cd ../../.. && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install -Dqameleon_DIR=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install/lib/cmake/qameleon && make -j$(nproc)
tasks.detail: Builds the QameleonGui project and the qameleon dependency

tasks.label: Build & run
tasks.command: cd libs/qameleon && mkdir -p build install && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=../install && make -j$(nproc) && make install && cd ../../.. && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install -Dqameleon_DIR=${workspaceFolder}/libs/qameleon/install/lib/cmake/qameleon && make -j$(nproc) && ./QameleonGUI
